Every night, Sarah pretended to be asleep. 🌙 And every night, Mom whispered the same words anyway.

At five, eyes squeezed shut. At nine, after a hard day, Mom whispered that it wasn't her fault, and Sarah cried quietly into her pillow. 😢

Stanford brain scans (2022) found that around age thirteen, kids' brains start tuning in more to new voices than to Mom's. 🧠 So at thirteen, it was "Mom, STOP!" And Mom just smiled.

At seventeen, boxes packed, Sarah pretended one last time. And this time, Mom smiled, because she knew Sarah had heard every word. ❤️ 2,945 nights.

The words were never just Mom's. Jesus had been told a little girl was gone. He walked into her room, took her by the hand and said, "Little girl, I say to you, arise." Mark 5:41 (ESV) 🙏 And she got up.

Jesus speaks to our kids in the dark, where they never have to face it alone. So whisper His words over them. ❤️ Even when they pretend not to listen.

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
